title: Constellations of Northside
summary: Jackie takes you to a Northside rooftop to name stars, where he invents three constellations and asks you for one of your own.

start.bringUp: Jackie invites you to a rooftop in Northside, and asks you to bring a jacket. He says he is naming stars.

g1.asks: What's yours called? And what's the story? There's always a story.
g1.know: V has just invented a constellation. The sky is above you, and a drone has flown across it, which Jackie has named The Delivery.
g1.secret: He made one for Misty and won't say.

stages.label: Jackie and V name constellations from a Northside rooftop
stages.know: You are on a rooftop in Northside with Jackie. He is naming constellations after food and tools, and a drone has just flown across the sky.
stages.wants: V to name a constellation and tell its story.

stayed.memory: You and Jackie named constellations from a Northside rooftop, and you named one yourself.
stayed.history: V named a constellation for Jackie on a Northside rooftop, and he kept the name.

left.memory: You and Jackie watched the Northside sky for a while, and then you went back down.

unfinished.memory: You and Jackie were doing something light, and it ended there.

variations.know: A smoggy sky, so Jackie does smog shapes instead of stars.
A clear, cold sky with more stars than the city usually shows.
Fireworks from a festival far off, lighting the rooftop every few seconds.
